tools.name: review_times
tools.description: How long AI app, connector and plugin stores take to review submissions. Omit store for all stores. Returns typical wait (median days to decision), counts, pace and how review works.

tools.name: report_submission
tools.description: Add the user's own submission to a store so others can see real wait times. Only call with the user's permission and for a real submission. Returns a token for updating it later.

tools.name: update_submission
tools.description: Mark a previously reported submission as still waiting, approved, rejected or withdrawn, using its token.
